findings.citation_text: For 3-D Moiré-based methods, the key problem is establishing the mapping between the Moiré patterns and the rotation angles. At this point, u-LentiMark [19] uses a look-up table and MoiréTag [20] relies on a learning-based model. Both produce implicit and somewhat ambiguous mappings. This leads to two problems. First, these methods might have transferability issues, as the performance can be unstable across different configurations and environments. Second, the factors influencing the accuracy remain unrecognized, which may lead to missed opportunities for potential improvements.
